import sys
from collections import deque

class CF1187G:
    def __init__(self):
        self.out = sys.stdout
        self.sc = self.Scanner(sys.stdin)
        self.INF = 0x3f3f3f3f
        self.aa_ = None
        self.n_ = 0
        self.m_ = 0
        self.pi = None
        self.dd = None
        self.bb = None
        self.qq = None
        self.iq = None
        self.uu = None
        self.vv = None
        self.uv = None
        self.cost = None
        self.cc = None

    class Scanner:
        def __init__(self, in_stream):
            self.in_stream = in_stream
            self.buffer = b''
            self.pos = 0
            self.size = 0

        def getc(self):
            if self.pos >= self.size:
                self.buffer = self.in_stream.read(1 << 15)
                self.size = len(self.buffer)
                self.pos = 0
                if self.size == 0:
                    return -1
            ch = self.buffer[self.pos]
            self.pos += 1
            return ch

        def nextInt(self):
            c = 0
            while c <= 32:
                c = self.getc()
                if c == -1:
                    return -1
            a = 0
            while c > 32:
                a = a * 10 + (c - ord('0'))
                c = self.getc()
                if c == -1:
                    break
            return a

    def init(self):
        self.aa_ = [list() for _ in range(self.n_)]
        self.pi = [self.INF] * self.n_
        self.dd = [0] * self.n_
        self.bb = [0] * self.n_
        self.qq = [0] * self.n_
        self.iq = [False] * self.n_
        self.uu = [0] * self.m_
        self.vv = [0] * self.m_
        self.uv = [0] * self.m_
        self.cost = [0] * self.m_
        self.cc = [0] * (self.m_ * 2)
        self.m_ = 0

    def link(self, u, v, cap, cos):
        h = self.m_
        self.m_ += 1
        self.uu[h] = u
        self.vv[h] = v
        self.uv[h] = u ^ v
        self.cost[h] = cos
        self.cc[h << 1] = cap
        self.aa_[u].append(h << 1)
        self.aa_[v].append(h << 1 | 1)

    def enqueue(self, v):
        if self.iq[v]:
            return
        if self.head + self.cnt == self.nq:
            if self.cnt * 2 <= self.nq:
                self.qq[0:self.cnt] = self.qq[self.head:self.head + self.cnt]
            else:
                self.nq *= 2
                qq_ = [0] * self.nq
                qq_[0:self.cnt] = self.qq[self.head:self.head + self.cnt]
                self.qq = qq_
            self.head = 0
        self.qq[self.head + self.cnt] = v
        self.cnt += 1
        self.iq[v] = True

    def dequeue(self):
        u = self.qq[self.head]
        self.head += 1
        self.cnt -= 1
        self.iq[u] = False
        return u

    def spfa(self, s, t):
        self.pi = [self.INF] * self.n_
        self.pi[s] = 0
        self.head = 0
        self.cnt = 0
        self.enqueue(s)
        while self.cnt > 0:
            u = self.dequeue()
            d = self.dd[u] + 1
            adj = self.aa_[u]
            for h_ in adj:
                if self.cc[h_] > 0:
                    h = h_ >> 1
                    p = self.pi[u] + (self.cost[h] if (h_ & 1) == 0 else -self.cost[h])
                    v = u ^ self.uv[h]
                    if self.pi[v] > p or (self.pi[v] == p and self.dd[v] > d):
                        self.pi[v] = p
                        self.dd[v] = d
                        self.bb[v] = h_
                        self.enqueue(v)
        return self.pi[t] != self.INF

    def push(self, s, t):
        c = self.INF
        u = t
        while u != s:
            h_ = self.bb[u]
            h = h_ >> 1
            c = min(c, self.cc[h_])
            u ^= self.uv[h]
        u = t
        while u != s:
            h_ = self.bb[u]
            h = h_ >> 1
            self.cc[h_] -= c
            self.cc[h_ ^ 1] += c
            u ^= self.uv[h]

    def push1(self, s, t):
        u = t
        while u != s:
            h_ = self.bb[u]
            h = h_ >> 1
            self.cc[h_] -= 1
            self.cc[h_ ^ 1] += 1
            u ^= self.uv[h]

    def edmonds_karp(self, s, t):
        while self.spfa(s, t):
            self.push1(s, t)
        c = 0
        for h in range(self.m_):
            c += self.cost[h] * self.cc[h << 1 | 1]
        return c

    def main(self):
        n = self.sc.nextInt()
        m = self.sc.nextInt()
        k = self.sc.nextInt()
        c = self.sc.nextInt()
        d = self.sc.nextInt()
        ii = [0] * k
        for h in range(k):
            ii[h] = self.sc.nextInt() - 1
        aa = [list() for _ in range(n)]
        for h in range(m):
            i = self.sc.nextInt() - 1
            j = self.sc.nextInt() - 1
            aa[i].append(j)
            aa[j].append(i)
        t = n + k + 1
        self.n_ = n * t + 1
        self.m_ = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (t - 1)
        self.init()
        for i in range(n):
            adj = aa[i]
            for s in range(t - 1):
                u = i * t + s
                for j in adj:
                    v = j * t + s + 1
                    for x in range(1, k + 1):
                        self.link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d)
        for i in range(n):
            for s in range(t - 1):
                u = i * t + s
                v = u + 1
                self.link(u, v, k, 0 if i == 0 else c)
        for h in range(k):
            self.link(self.n_ - 1, ii[h] * t + 0, 1, 0)
        self.println(self.edmonds_karp(self.n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1))

    def println(self, x):
        self.out.write(str(x) + '\n')
        self.out.flush()

    o = CF1187G()
    o.main()
